name: localflame
description: Firecrawl v2 search and scrape through a compact, lossless, section-addressable MCP surface.

environment_variables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_URL
environment_variables.description: Firecrawl base URL; /v2 is normalized automatically.

environment_variables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Optional bearer token for an authenticated compatible endpoint.

environment_variables.name: LOCALFLAME_MAX_RESOURCES
environment_variables.description: Maximum Firecrawl results retained by one MCP process.

environment_variables.name: LOCALFLAME_MAX_RESOURCE_BYTES
environment_variables.description: Maximum UTF-8 content bytes retained by one MCP process.

tools.name: firecrawl_search
tools.description: Search through Firecrawl v2 and retain full results as ordered sections.

tools.name: firecrawl_scrape
tools.description: Scrape a URL through Firecrawl v2 and retain its complete normalized result.

tools.name: firecrawl_read
tools.description: Read exact sections from a retained result.

tools.name: firecrawl_find
tools.description: Find exact phrases or intersecting words in retained result sections.

tools.name: firecrawl_outline
tools.description: Page through compact metadata for a retained result.

tools.name: firecrawl_images
tools.description: List image references already found in retained result sections.

tools.name: firecrawl_resources
tools.description: List results retained by the current MCP process.
